novelty_review.scope: Internal engineering review for native validation; not external acceptance
novelty_review.rationale: Service access and retention are coupled: the lid closes under gravity, capped rails require horizontal entry, and closing the lid captures the retaining bar. The fixture represents nonenergized enclosure maintenance.
novelty_review.risk: Moderate overlap in component insertion and held access; acceptance depends on the real retention dependency being visible and validated.

review_notes: Passive mechanics, source-defined contact geometry, measured-state controller and native probes implemented. Offline geometry cannot establish physical success. No task may enter the submission handoff before runtime evidence passes.
